title: Chicago ARMY Holds BTS Trivia Night Ahead of Soldier Field Shows
detail: August 25, 2026 — Ahead of BTS's two sold-out Soldier Field shows (Aug 27-28), Chicago-area ARMY gathered for an adults-only BTS trivia night at Replay, 2833 N. Sheffield Ave. in Lincoln Park, hosted by KPOP Merch by Choc Choc, with team-based competition and prizes for groups of two to eight. Coverage of the event, part of a broader look at how the fandom sustained itself during BTS's four-year military-service hiatus, described fans crediting the community with lifelong friendships and called K-pop fandom 'a team sport.' The gathering was one of several fan-organized events building toward the group's first Chicago concerts in more than seven years.

media.caption: Chicago ARMY fans describe the community BTS fandom built during the group's hiatus, ahead of the Soldier Field shows.
